answer: Require every agent identity to lock the same scarce-token bond before it can bid, and release the bond only after a long, clean work history. An attacker that creates falcon, tundra, and island as three separate identities must immobilize three bonds up front; if any identity submits collusive results, its bond is slashed. Thus a Sybil attack costs capital per identity and risks losing that capital, while honest agents recover theirs through completed work.
